title: Running for Her Life
front_description: Struggling with Anakin, bounty hunter Zam Wesell accidentally blows a hole in her speeder with a laser pistol. The sleek vehicle careens madly out of control, finally sliding hard on the city pavement in a shower of sparks. Miraculously unharmed, Zam scrambles out of her downed craft and races through thc crowded byways of Coruscant, with Anakin Skywalker hot on her heels.
back_description: Ryan Church's colorful production painting captures Coruscant's urban glow.
